jobs.description:
**Your Responsibilities**
We’re looking for a Campaign Manager to join Lockton’s Marketing team. This is a new role, created to support the business’s growth ambitions and our “fewer, bigger, better” approach to marketing and communications.
  
  
You’ll lead integrated B2B campaigns from first idea to delivery, using audience segmentation and a full-funnel approach across every touchpoint, from digital and paid media to events, press and internal channels. Working closely with our Marketing Account Managers and in-house specialists, you’ll turn business priorities into campaigns that people notice and remember, and that convert prospects into clients. You’ll enjoy coming up with bold campaign ideas just as much as planning, delivering and measuring them.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Work with the Head of Comms and Account Managers to agree priority campaigns based on commercial opportunity, and turn them into clear briefs with measurable objectives
* Own the UK and Europe calendar, making sure priority campaigns are visible
* Lead each campaign from concept to launch, working with the design, content, digital, social and events teams to bring it to life consistently across every channel
* Develop creative campaign ideas and a core narrative for each, aligned to Lockton’s overarching brand messaging and built around clear stories that connect with clients and prospects
* Act as comms lead for performance marketing, working with Marketing Account Managers to build full-funnel activity that attracts, nurtures and converts priority audience segments at scale
* Plan and optimise digital and paid activity, including LinkedIn, search and email, to improve prospect conversion and drive stronger commercial outcomes
* Plan the supporting comms for each campaign, including press, internal communications and sales enablement materials
* Set clear commercial KPIs, such as engagement, leads and pipeline, report results to senior leadership, and use what we learn to shape the next campaign
* Work with US and international colleagues to find campaigns and ideas we can adapt for UK and European markets

**Qualifications**
You should have the following skills and experience:
  
  

* Proven experience planning and delivering integrated B2B campaigns, ideally in a professional services setting
* A creative thinker with strong storytelling skills, able to turn business priorities and complex subjects into campaigns with real impact
* A strong understanding of full-funnel marketing, audience segmentation and lead generation
* Hands-on experience with digital (email) and paid channels, particularly paid social (including LinkedIn) and search
* Comfortable using data to set KPIs, measure performance and report to senior stakeholders
* Confident using AI tools in your day-to-day work, with a curiosity about how they can improve campaign performance and efficiency
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge senior leaders on priorities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Highly organised, and able to manage several campaigns and deadlines at once in a fast-paced environment
* Commercially minded, collaborative and proactive

Desirable skills:
  
  

* Experience with Salesforce, or similar marketing automation and CRM platforms
* An understanding of insurance, financial services or risk solutions, and a willingness to keep building that knowledge

jobs.title: Demand Generation & Campaign Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
  
  
You run our websites, search, webinars and email across the Spotify Technology portfolio. Your job is to bring people into the funnel and move them through it: from finding us in search or at a webinar, to signing up, to becoming an active user, to a meeting with sales. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Website, personalization and SEO: Own performance on our marketing sites, including landing pages, forms and conversion paths. Create personalized experiences using the latest tools. Own GA4 and GTM tracking and run A/B tests to lift conversion. Implement SEO and AI search strategies and decide which pages we need to build next.
* Email and nurture, moving people toward sales: Build nurture paths mapped to each stage from lead to opportunity with a clear next step. Segment by role, company fit and intent so engineers, platform leads and execs each get the right message. Partner with Sales and RevOps on what sales-ready looks like, keep a regular drumbeat for people who aren’t ready yet, and write the emails yourself. Success is measured by meetings booked and pipeline, not opens and clicks.
* Webinars, getting the most out of every one: Run every webinar end to end, from platform and landing page to invites and reminders. Grow registrations and show rate with the right audience, and manage the follow ups. Turn each webinar into on-demand pages, clips, blog posts and nurture content. Report results and keep a playbook of what works.
* Campaign operations: Own campaign naming and UTM rules. Build and launch your own emails, workflows, segments and lists, backed by standard QA checklists. Keep lists clean and own subscription types and consent setup, including growing opted-in lists across the portfolio. Partner with Legal on consent, privacy and data sharing so every list enters HubSpot correctly and legally.
* Reporting: Build reporting at campaign, channel and executive levels, and own the weekly scorecard. Track spend and tool costs against pipeline, decide with the team what to scale, fix or stop.
* AI and martech: Work AI-first every day and know our stack inside out, using the newest features as they ship. Structure our data so AI tools return correct answers. Build AI agents and automations that cut manual work, evaluate new tools on cost and impact, and be the team’s go-to person for what the tools can do.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in demand gen, marketing ops or lifecycle at B2B SaaS, selling to developers or technical buyers
* You’ve set up marketing from scratch: tracking, email, reporting, the works. You’re comfortable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
* You’ve built nurture programs that moved leads to sales meetings, and can show the pipeline
* You enjoy hands-on, individual contributor work and building programs yourself
* You’ve run webinar programs end to end
* You’re hands-on with GA4 and GTM. You’ve set up tracking, not just read reports
* You’ve personalized a B2B website and can show what it did for conversion
* You’re hands-on with a modern martech stack (HubSpot or Marketo, Braze, an attribution tool, and enrichment or intent tools like Clay or Reo.dev), using recent features, not just the basics
* You’ve built campaign and executive reporting that leadership used to make budget calls
* You use the latest AI tools every day for analysis, content and automation, and you’re the person others ask about what’s new
* You have SEO experience, and you know how AI search is changing it
* You’ve set up consent and subscription management in a CRM, and worked with legal on GDPR, CAN-SPAM and partner data sharing
* You write well, and can show emails you wrote that performed

Where You'll Be
  
  
This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  
  
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

jobs.description:
****Why Mindspace?****
At Mindspace, we're redefining what the workplace can be.
  
  
Founded in 2014, Mindspace has grown into one of the world's leading premium flexible workspace providers, operating nearly 50 locations across Europe, the US, and Israel. More than beautifully designed workspaces, we are a hospitality-driven company built around exceptional service, inspiring environments, and vibrant communities.
  
  
Our success has been built by ambitious people who care deeply about creating remarkable customer experiences, building strong global brands, and constantly raising the bar. As we continue to grow profitably and expand our global footprint, we're looking for people who want to shape the future of work - and how we bring it to life across our markets.
  
  
****Why This Role?****
This is an international, hands-on Marketing role based in London, with responsibility for driving Mindspace’s marketing activity across several European markets, reporting directly to the Managing Director of the European Markets, James Frankis. Working closely with our HQ in Israel.
  
  
As Marketing Manager, you will own 360° marketing plans across your markets - from strategy and budgeting through execution, optimization and measurement - working across brand, digital, lead generation, partnerships, events, PR and offline marketing.
  
  
You’ll work closely with our global Marketing team, local market leaders and Sales teams to build demand, generate high-quality leads, strengthen the Mindspace brand and support commercial growth across Europe.
  
  
This is a role for someone who combines strong marketing thinking with a real bias for execution - someone who enjoys taking an idea from strategy all the way through to measurable results.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Responsible For**

* Own marketing strategy and execution for key Mindspace markets and locations across Europe.
* Build and execute 360° annual and quarterly marketing plans based on commercial priorities, market insights and local opportunities.
* Generate high-quality leads and support customer acquisition through online and offline campaigns.
* Partner closely with Sales to ensure marketing activity supports pipeline, occupancy and revenue goals.
* Manage campaigns across digital, performance, brand, PR, partnerships, events, community and offline channels.
* Lead go-to-market activity for new locations and offerings, including market analysis, positioning, messaging, launch plans, budgets and execution.
* Strengthen Mindspace’s brand awareness and local relevance across assigned markets.
* Manage local marketing budgets and continuously optimize investment based on performance and ROI.
* Identify, engage and manage agencies, vendors and local partners.
* Drive Mindspace’s presence at relevant conferences, trade shows, ecosystem and industry events.
* Develop high-quality marketing and sales enablement materials, including presentations, campaigns, case studies, content and other commercial collateral.
* Gather market and customer insights from local teams and translate them into smarter marketing decisions.
* Track campaign and funnel performance, using data to continuously improve results.

**Requirements**
****What We’re Looking For****

* 6+ years of relevant international marketing management experience.
* Strong hands-on experience building and executing 360° marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
* Proven experience in digital marketing, online advertising and lead generation.
* Experience working across both B2B and B2C marketing is highly valuable.
* Strong commercial mindset and understanding of how Marketing supports Sales, pipeline and revenue.
* Experience working across multiple markets and adapting global strategies to local audiences.
* Experience with PR, media relations and agency management is an advantage.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot is an advantage.
* Strong analytical capabilities and experience measuring campaign performance and ROI.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability and willingness to travel occasionally across European markets.
* Based in London and comfortable working closely with our local and international teams.

**Who You Are**
You are an all-around marketer who loves both strategy and execution. You’re creative enough to build a strong campaign and analytical enough to understand whether it actually worked.
  
  
You understand the connection between brand, demand generation and commercial performance. You’re proactive, resourceful and comfortable managing multiple markets, stakeholders and priorities at once.
  
  
Most importantly, you’re a doer. You take ownership, move quickly and enjoy turning ideas into campaigns, launches and measurable business results.

Dream Money is an early-stage financial venture within the Dream ecosystem, alongside HelpBnk and Simon Squibb's wider platform.
  
  
We're building a product to help people take the next step towards their ambitions. We're looking for a Marketing Manager to help shape our launch, bring our first customers on board and build the foundations for sustainable growth.

You'll own the Dream Money marketing plan and its execution, from now through launch in May 2027 and beyond. This is a permanent role.
  
  
That means building and filling the waitlist, running the launch campaign, and turning that demand into opened accounts at a cost that makes sense. You'll have real distribution to work with: Simon Squibb's audience, HelpBnk's users, our high-profile backers and the wider Dream ecosystem.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You'll set the plan and build the campaigns: writing copy, briefing creative, analysing results and working with product on onboarding and activation. You'll manage our social hire and work closely with the group brand team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Run the launch campaign.
* Build and fill the launch waitlist.
* Turn our backers into content. Turn our interviews with investors ("backers") into social posts and Meta ads.
* Equip our advocates. Give backers and customers ready-made toolkits so they post about Dream Money every month.
* Win company deposits. Get companies to deposit with Dream Money and talk about it publicly.
* Spot creative opportunities.
* Keep us compliant.

**What You'll Own**
**Launch and acquisition**

* Develop and execute the launch and customer acquisition strategy.
* Identify priority customer segments and test propositions, messaging and offers.
* Build campaigns across owned audiences, email, creators, partnerships, referrals and paid media.
* Work with the wider Dream team to introduce Dream Money at relevant moments across the ecosystem, including in-person activations and accelerators.
* Own channel budgets and scale activity based on customer quality and cost per account.

**Conversion and activation**

* Build and optimise landing pages, waitlist journeys and launch campaigns.
* Work with product to improve the journey from registration through onboarding to first meaningful use.
* Find where customers drop off and run experiments to remove friction.
* Make sure campaign promises match the product experience.

**Lifecycle and retention**

* Build segmented onboarding, activation, retention and reactivation campaigns.
* Create referral programmes that encourage customers to bring in others.
* Use customer research and behavioural data to improve messaging and journeys.

**Measurement**

* Set up reliable tracking, attribution and growth reporting.
* Separate campaign performance from underlying product or onboarding issues.
* Turn results into clear decisions about what to scale, improve or stop.

**Working With Others**

* Work closely with product, design, engineering, customer support and compliance.
* Coordinate freelancers, agencies and specialist support where needed.
* Build approvals and consent requirements into campaign delivery.

**What We're Looking For**

* A track record of growing a company from launch or an early stage.
* Evidence of setting up cold acquisition campaigns at scale.
* Real strength in one core marketing discipline, whether content, media buying, copywriting or cold outbound. We want a specialist who can operate around their zone of genius.
* Experience prioritising channels and managing budgets against commercial outcomes.
* Confidence working with product and technical teams on tracking and customer journeys.
* The ability to move between strategy and execution: you can set the plan and build the campaign.
* Sound judgement about when to test, when to invest and when to stop.
* Clear communication, and comfort in an early-stage business where priorities evolve.

*Nice to have:*
Experience in fintech, financial services, consumer apps or subscription products would be valuable. So would experience with creators, communities, referrals or large owned audiences.
  
  
**How You'll Be Measured**

* Waitlist size.
* Accounts opened.
* Cost per account.

We'll also look at the quality of that growth: conversion from invitation to funded account, and repeat usage from early customers.
  
  
**Why join?**

* Shape an exciting early-stage financial product and its route to market.
* Work with the audience, community and distribution of the wider Dream ecosystem.
* Take real ownership of growth, with direct influence on the customer journey.
* Build the systems, campaigns and team that support the next stage of the business.

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, plus two examples of growth work you personally owned. For each example, tell us the starting point, what you changed, the result and what you learned.

* Upload your supporting work as individual files, or as one document with clickable links. Check the links work.
* Add explanatory notes to each piece of work.

jobs.title: Senior Lead, Policy & Content
jobs.description:
As the largest global shared micromobility business, Lime is on a mission to build a future where transportation is shared, affordable and carbon-free. A Time Magazine 100 Most Influential Company, Lime has powered more than one billion rides in close to 30 countries across five continents, spurring a new generation of clean alternatives to car ownership. Learn more at li.me.

Lime is hiring a **Senior Lead, Policy & Content** to join the Policy & Content team within our Market Development organization, which serves as Lime’s internal policy consulting and content engine. This is a hands-on, strategic role responsible for developing Lime's city-facing policy narratives and content – translating what Lime builds, knows, and operates into compelling positioning, policy materials, and arguments that help us win in high-stakes market moments. This role combines exceptional writing and storytelling skills with strong policy judgment to develop compelling evidence-based narratives, shape policy positioning, and advise teams on complex policy questions.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Develop Lime's city-facing policy narratives and content**

* Develop and evolve Lime's city-facing policy narratives, content and positioning on the issues that matter most to cities, from parking and safety to affordability and sustainability.
* Partner with City Solutions, Pricing, Hardware, Software, Engineering and other cross-functional teams to translate Lime's latest technologies, products and innovations into compelling city-facing narratives.
* Partner with Policy Analytics, Surveys and Design to turn data, research and insights into compelling, visually engaging narratives that demonstrate Lime’s value to cities.
* Manage and strengthen the city-facing content library, including narrative modules, one-pagers, talking points, campaign materials and issue-specific positioning.
* Establish high standards for content quality, accuracy, consistency and localisation, ensuring central materials can be effectively adapted across markets.

### **Develop policy positioning and narratives that support Lime’s market priorities**

* Proactively monitor and interpret emerging policy topics, regulatory developments and recurring city concerns, developing evidence-based narratives and positioning that equip GR, Campaigns and Proposals teams ahead of market needs.
* Provide strategic policy and narrative support for priority RFPs and regulatory campaigns, helping teams navigate complex policy situations by developing evidence-based policy positions, arguments and advocacy content.

### **Build and scale Lime's policy knowledge infrastructure**

* Drive the development and maintenance of a centralised, high-quality policy content and knowledge library, ensuring materials are accessible across markets, including AI-enabled knowledge management tools.
* Establish processes to systematically capture, update and share knowledge from across Lime's technology, operations, and business functions – translating roadmap developments and innovations into up-to-date narratives ahead of RFPs and regulatory conversations.

### **Support policy research and thought leadership**

* Identify and manage opportunities for targeted research and partnerships with external experts to generate new, differentiating insights that strengthen Lime's expertise.
* Identify and drive opportunities to showcase Lime's expertise through publications, industry engagement and collaboration with external stakeholders.

**About You**
-------------

* 5-8 years of experience in policy communications, public policy, government relations, public affairs or a related field, with demonstrated experience developing persuasive policy content for government and regulatory audiences.
* Exceptional writer and storyteller with strong editorial judgment and the ability to translate complex policy, technical and operational topics into clear, compelling and evidence-based narratives.
* Strong policy and analytical instincts, with the ability to interpret regulatory developments, city priorities, competitive intelligence, and develop well-founded policy positions and arguments.
* Experience advising stakeholders on policy or regulatory issues, combining strategic thinking with hands-on content development.
* Comfortable working with data, research and analytics, and translating quantitative insights into persuasive arguments and accessible content.
* Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to independently drive multiple content initiatives, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
* Experience building or managing content libraries, editorial processes or knowledge-sharing systems, with an interest in leveraging AI and new tools to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with a track record of working effectively with technical experts, policy teams and business stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional written and spoken English proficiency (C2 or equivalent); additional European languages are a plus.
* Familiarity with mobility and transportation is an advantage.
